newsitem.title: USA: Country Seat Stores file for bankruptcy.
newsitem.headline: Country Seat Stores file for bankruptcy.

text.p: County Seat Stores Inc and two affiliates filed for Chapter 11 protection on Thursday in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Delaware.

The company listed assets of $194.9 million and liabilities of $254.1 million. County Seat Holding Inc listed assets of $3 million and liabilities of $221.5 million and CSS Trade Names Inc listed assets of $69.6 million and liabilities of $92.8 million.
County Seat is based in Dallas, Texas.
No other information about the bankruptcy is available at this time.
